result:
I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

- **Layout:** The page is white and one column, up to 1120px wide, with 48px above and 32px at the sides. The "Requests" heading is Unbounded Light in capitals at `--text-heading`.
- **Message:** It's centered, with the title in Unbounded Medium at `--text-title` and the line in muted body text. The button and link sit below it.
- **Button:** "Create a Request" is the one primary button, a 44px ink pill. I left it out of the top-right slot DESIGN.md gives the screen's primary action, because the spec allows only one primary button per screen.
- **Link:** "Import from a spreadsheet" is a plain underlined link in `--accent-text` with a 44px target, not a button.
- **Tokens:** I inlined only the tokens the screen uses, in both themes. There are no raw hex values in the component styles.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't available in this folder, so they fall back to the system font until the real fonts load.
